description: The line plot illustrates the performance change, measured by the minimum F1 score, of different methods as the ratio of the in-context pool size increases. The x-axis, labeled "Ratio," is a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled "minF1D20 (±)," is also a linear scale ranging from 0.8 to 1.3, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different method: TrajICL (blue line with circle markers), Head Tuning (orange line with square markers), FT (green line with triangle markers), LoRA 16 (red line with diamond markers), and LoRA 64 (purple line with cross markers). The TrajICL line starts at a value of approximately 1.3 and decreases steadily to a value of about 0.9. The Head Tuning line begins at around 1.2 and also decreases, ending near 0.9. The FT line starts at approximately 1.1 and decreases to about 0.8. The LoRA 16 line begins at around 1.1 and ends near 0.9. Lastly, the LoRA 64 line starts at about 1.1 and decreases to approximately 0.8. The plot shows a general trend of decreasing performance as the ratio increases for all methods.
